_comment: Same fences as zones.json, plus a ground-plane calibration. ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY: these four correspondences were chosen to give the bundled demo clip plausible metric behaviour, NOT surveyed from a real camera. For a real deployment, mark four points on the ground whose real positions you have measured, note where they appear in the camera image, and put those pairs here.

calibration._comment: image = normalized 0-1 frame position of a known ground point. world = its real position in metres: X across the scene, Y distance from the camera.
